purpose: Unfilled delivery and evidence protocol for batch339 performance drafts; no pupil data or performance supplied.
preconditions: Independent class/subject/rubric calibration and teacher permission before delivery.
Accessible desk-level safe paper/clip tasks only; no pins, tools, climbing, damaged fixtures, public campaigning or real visits.
Use fictional family roles, respect all learners and allow an equivalent accessible means of participation; no personal/family/religious disclosure.
Use live examiner observation; recording only with appropriate consent and local policy. No recording required where live observation suffices.
evidenceRequirements: Record the individual learner’s actual words/actions against each positive-mark criterion.
Do not infer participation from a plan or a group’s finished product; do not award performance marks for written preparation alone.
Stop or adapt a task if the agreed safe/accessibility conditions are unavailable.
